children: Falcon Finance plans an unlock of about 203.06 million FF in November 2027. The amount equals 5.73% of the token's circulating supply. The release covers allocations for the ecosystem, the foundation, investors and the team.
The release makes the unlocked tokens available for sale. If recipients choose to sell them, more FF will be offered on the market, adding potential selling pressure.

title: Falcon Finance: FF unlock releases about 203.06 million tokens - Nov 2027
